LanguageData.CBF_P_NewTip: New piece: the window folds away and you paint the area on the map.
LanguageData.CBF_P_OpenFileTip: Opens the file of the selected piece in your text editor. The editor reloads changes made there on its own.
LanguageData.CBF_P_PickOne: Pick a piece on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ListHint: Right-click: rename, duplicate, mark as template, delete
LanguageData.CBF_P_OnMap: placed on the map for editing
LanguageData.CBF_P_ImageHint: Drag anchors directly in the image. To change the structure, put the piece on the map with Place to edit.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ImageHintMap: The piece is on the map. Change the structure there and set anchors here in the image. After the export the image shows the new shape.
LanguageData.CBF_P_PaintTip: Drag a rectangle in the image. It becomes the area of the selected anchor. Right-click or Escape puts the tool away.
LanguageData.CBF_P_EraseTip: Drag a rectangle in the image. All anchor cells inside it are removed.
LanguageData.CBF_P_PlaceEditTip: Puts the piece on the map so its structure can be changed. The window folds away and the toolbox appears on the right. If it is already there, the camera jumps to it.
LanguageData.CBF_P_NewNeedsMap: A new piece needs an open map.
LanguageData.CBF_P_NoAnchors: No anchors yet. Add one with + Anchor and drag it in the image.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AnchorAreaTip: Select this anchor and drag its area in the image.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AnchorCopyTip: Adds a copy with the same settings but without an area. Drag the area in the image afterwards.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AddAnchorTip: Add a new anchor and drag it in the image right away.
LanguageData.CBF_P_FromOtherTip: Takes over the anchors of another piece with their settings, without areas.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AnchorOverTip: The anchor lies above the first layer and may overlap its anchors. Placing it clears nothing underneath, for example a market tent over a stall or a fur rug under a table.
LanguageData.CBF_P_SingleKindOff: Only used without a pawn list.
LanguageData.CBF_P_CheckTip: Checks the piece. On the map this runs the full export check, otherwise the check of the file.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ExportNeedsMap: Export only works while the piece is placed on the map for editing.
LanguageData.CBF_P_UnsavedSwitch: {0} has unsaved changes. Switch anyway? Unsaved anchors will be lost.
LanguageData.CBF_BK_NeedCategory: The piece cannot be exported without a category.
LanguageData.CBF_BK_Hint: Set anchors in the editor image after the export. A changed piece keeps its anchors when exported.
LanguageData.CBF_BK_Placing: Click on the map to place the piece.
LanguageData.CBF_BK_PaintFirst: Paint the area of the new piece on the map.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorOutsideAll: Anchor {0} lies completely outside the piece area and is dropped on export.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorOutsideSome: Anchor {0} loses {1} cells outside the piece area on export.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorOverlaps: Anchor {0} overlaps {1}. Only one anchor per cell is possible. Move the copy first or adjust the area.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ShowLootTip: Shows what the loot table {0} gives.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ShowPawnsTip: Opens the pawn list {0} in the Pawn tab. The arrow at the top left brings you back.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AtWallTip: How much this piece wants to stand at the town wall. Required forces contact, Forbidden rules it out. Without a value of its own, the category's wall contact applies.
LanguageData.CBF_P_WeightTip: How often this piece is drawn when several fit. Empty takes the weight of the category.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorConnect_Wall: The town wall docks here. A gatehouse needs at least two cells of it.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorConnect_Outside: Shows which side of the piece faces outward. A gatehouse needs it, otherwise the generator turns the gate the wrong way round.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorConnect_Annex: The generator attaches annexes here. On the house the anchor lies on the outer wall, on the annex on the shared wall or one cell outside its shape.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorConnect_Water: Marks the water side of a harbor piece. The generator only places the piece where these cells lie on water.
LanguageData.CBF_P_OnlyFactionsTip: The piece is only used in settlements of these factions. Empty means every faction. Other pieces of the same category stay available to everyone.
LanguageData.CBF_P_NoFactionsTip: The piece is never used in settlements of these factions.
LanguageData.CBF_P_ModTip: Show only pieces from one mod. Pieces from a subfolder like Mods/MedievalOverhaul are listed separately.
LanguageData.CBF_P_IdeoBuildingTip: Places a building of the faction's ideoligion here, such as an altar or a ritual spot, instead of the object list.
LanguageData.CBF_P_OnlyWithModTip: The piece is only placed when all mods listed here are active. Use it for pieces that need things of another mod.
LanguageData.CBF_P_OffWithModTip: The piece is not placed when one of the mods listed here is active. Use it for pieces that another mod replaces.
LanguageData.CBF_AnchorConnect_Socket: A docking point for dungeon parts. Corridors, caves or other rooms connect here. Doors and openings on the outer edge count as docking points anyway, this anchor offers one explicitly.
LanguageData.CBF_SocketTypeTip: What the generator puts here when something docks: door, open arch, cave opening or secret passage.
LanguageData.CBF_SocketWidthTip: Width of the opening in cells, 1 to 5. Only sockets of the same width connect.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AnchorsFromFileTip: Reload the anchors from the piece file. Useful when the file was changed after the piece was placed on the map.
LanguageData.CBF_P_AnchorsFromFileAsk: Replace the anchors on the map with the ones from the file? Changes to the anchors that were not exported yet are lost.
LanguageData.CBF_ExportPatchAsk: {0} belongs to {1}. Its file stays untouched; your version is saved as a patch in your mod {2}. Continue?
LanguageData.CBF_TDesc_exportPatch: This piece belongs to another mod. The export saves your changes as a patch in your own mod, the original file stays untouched.
LanguageData.CBF_TDesc_exportCopy: Save it as a new piece with its own name in your mod. The original stays as it is.
